name: Old Ironforge
summary: Old Ironforge, also called the Assembly of Thanes, is an ancient subterranean chamber lying directly beneath the High Seat of Ironforge. Carved deep into the mountain's roots above glowing magma veins, it represents the ancestral heart of the dwarven capital. In the present day, its heavy access gates in the royal throne room remain sealed and vigilantly guarded.

sections.title: The Assembly of Thanes
sections.body: Beneath King Magni Bronzebeard's throne in the High Seat rests the cavernous hall known as Old Ironforge or the Assembly of Thanes. Deep inside these fiery subterranean foundations, winding stone bridges cross pools of subterranean lava. Long before the bustling halls of the Great Forge and the Commons echoed with modern dwarven commerce, early thanes gathered in these cavernous depths to deliberate and govern the mountain kingdom.

sections.title: A Sealed Chamber
sections.body: Currently, entrance to Old Ironforge from the throne room is securely barred. The Ironforge royal guard keeps strict watch over the thresholds leading down into the old vaults.

faq.answer: Old Ironforge, historically known as the Assembly of Thanes, is the ancient lower district carved directly beneath the modern city of Ironforge. It consists of cavernous halls and lava conduits.

aliases: how to get into old ironforge
faq.answer: Not through the throne room. The gates in the High Seat are sealed shut and guarded by the dwarven royal guard, and the chambers below are closed to ordinary citizens. The depths are not entirely quiet, though: Dark Iron maps show tunnels converging on a point beneath Ironforge itself.
The entrance is located directly inside the High Seat, the royal audience chamber where King Magni Bronzebeard sits in the city of Ironforge.

faq.q: Why is Old Ironforge significant to dwarven history?
aliases: why is it called assembly of thanes
faq.answer: Known as the Assembly of Thanes, it served as an ancient meeting ground for dwarven leaders and mountain kings in early eras before the upper rings of the modern mountain capital were fully established.

angles.text: For dwarves, Old Ironforge and the Assembly of Thanes are sacred connections to their ancestral roots, preserving the deepest stone foundations carved out during the dawn of their mountain realm.
The sealed gates of the High Seat are watched closely by King Magni's guards, and anyone caught meddling with the old halls below would face stern dwarven justice.
